SGI-20: GMR TACH ADAPTER


From Dakota Digital

Take the guesswork out of tachometer signal conversion. The Dakota Digital SGI-20 uses an advanced GMR (Giant Magnetoresistance) pickup to clamp directly onto a low-voltage, high-current wire.  No splicing, no cutting, no permanent modifications to your existing wiring harness.

Once installed, the SGI-20 converts the detected signal into a clean, stable 12-volt square wave output that modern instrumentation can reliably read. Whether you're retrofitting a classic hot rod, upgrading a custom build, or troubleshooting a signal compatibility issue in the shop, the SGI-20 delivers a consistent signal your gauges or engine management system can trust.

Common Applications:

  • CDI (Capacitor Discharge) ignitions
  • Coil-over-plug setups
  • Distributorless coil packs
  • Diesel injector signals
  • Any low-voltage, high-current trigger source requiring a clean 12V square wave output

Key Features:

  • GMR pickup attaches without splicing for a clean, non-destructive install
  • Converts low-voltage high-current signals to a clean 12V square wave output
  • Compatible with receiving devices configurable to a 1-cylinder input
  • Ideal for DIY enthusiasts, custom builders, and professional installers alike
